verdicts.reason: A splits the layout sensibly: the quote sits on the left and the can in its circle on the right. Its flaws are a large dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, a tiny can whose 'SOLSTICE' label can't be read, and a logo crammed in on the attribution's baseline at the right. B makes the quote bigger and more readable, but the text runs tight against the right edge. Its can is jammed against the bottom edge, and the logo floats at an arbitrary mid-right spot, so the bottom half looks scattered and unbalanced.
